author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have developed a universal cartilage scaffold that can trigger the body's own stem cells to regenerate bone tissue without immune rejection. This off-the-shelf solution uses decellularized extracellular matrix cues to promote endochondral ossification and vascularization, achieving full bone repair in animal models.  

Source Article: https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2507185123
